passive.name: Wretched Strength
passive.text: +1% damage for every 1% of missing health (Dharok's set effect).

q.name: Greataxe Cleave
q.text: A wide crushing swing in a cone. Bonus damage equal to half his passive.

w.name: Rock Cake
w.text: Eat it to lose 15% of current health (can't drop below 1) and gain 20% move speed for 3s.

e.name: Saradomin Brew
e.text: Heal 25% of missing health over 2s and gain armour, but deal 15% less damage meanwhile.

r.name: Granite Maul Combo
r.text: An instant extra hit with no wind-up. Castable twice in a row with a full bar.

passive.name: 1 Defence
passive.text: Takes and deals 15% more damage; special attack energy regenerates 50% faster.

q.name: Energy Drain
q.text: An empowered whip hit that slows 30% for 2s and gives the Pure that move speed.

w.name: Sever
w.text: A dragon scimitar slash that disables all of the target's prayers for 5s.

e.name: Step Under
e.text: Dash beneath the target; for 0.75s nothing can melee the Pure.

r.name: Puncture
r.text: Two rapid dragon dagger stabs. A full bar is four specs.

passive.name: Blighted Power
passive.text: Every 4th spell or attack deals 30% bonus damage (Ahrim's set effect).

q.name: Ice Barrage
q.text: A 3x3 area that roots for 1.5s. Rooted targets get 3s of freeze immunity afterwards.

w.name: Blood Barrage
w.text: Area damage that heals the mage for 25% of damage dealt.

e.name: Shadow Barrage
e.text: Area damage that lowers enemy damage by 15% for 3s.

r.name: Immolate
r.text: Volatile nightmare staff: a long-range bolt, +50% against targets below 30% health.

passive.name: Gear Switch
passive.text: Alternates Range and Mage forms. First attack after a switch deals +20%; hits on a style the target isn't protecting deal +10%.

q.text: Range form: Ruby bolt (e) deals 20% of the target's current health and costs 10% of yours. Mage form: Ice Blitz roots one target for 1.5s.

w.name: Tele Block
w.text: The target can't teleport, recall or dash for 4s.

e.name: Switch
e.text: Swap forms instantly and gain a short burst of speed.

r.name: Freeze & Spec
r.text: An Ice Barrage root, then an Armadyl crossbow spec with double accuracy (a guaranteed critical).

passive.name: Twisted Bow
passive.text: Damage scales with the target's magic power, and +20% against epic monsters.

q.name: Rapid
q.text: Switch to the Rapid attack style: +30% attack speed for 4s.

w.name: Black Chinchompa
w.text: A thrown explosive; more damage closer to the centre.

e.name: Longrange
e.text: Switch to Longrange: +2 tiles of range and +15% defence for 4s, but 20% slower.

r.name: Twisted Volley
r.text: A piercing arrow that crosses the map; damage scales with each hit champion's magic power. (The twisted bow has no spec in OSRS; this one is invented.)

passive.name: Venom
passive.text: Hits apply venom: damage every second that grows 4, 6, 8 … up to 20, as in OSRS.

w.name: Zulrah's Scales
w.text: Lob a pool of venom that slows and envenoms.

e.name: Stamina
e.text: A burst of move speed and attack speed for 2s.

r.name: Toxic Siphon
r.text: A heavy hit that heals for 50% of the damage dealt, as in OSRS.

champions.name: Slayer
champions.title: the Jungler
champions.build: Slayer helm + abyssal tentacle + dwarf multicannon

passive.name: Slayer Task
passive.text: +16.7% damage against monsters (the Slayer helm bonus). Main account: has protection prayers.

q.name: Tentacle Lash
q.text: A whip hit with a 25% chance to root for 1s.

w.name: Dwarf Multicannon
w.text: Set up a cannon that auto-fires at enemies and monsters for 8s.

e.name: Agility Shortcut
e.text: Vault over a wall in a chosen direction.

r.name: Warhammer Smash
r.text: Dragon warhammer: a crushing hit that lowers the target's defence by 30% for 6s.

champions.name: Zerker
champions.title: Berserker build
champions.build: Berserker helm + Tzhaar weapons + berserker necklace

passive.name: Berserker Necklace
passive.text: Each attack within 3s stacks +3% damage, up to 5 stacks.

q.name: Obsidian Maul Crush
q.text: A slow, wide Tzhaar-ket-om swing that stuns for 0.75s.

e.name: Wilderness Lever
e.text: Pull a lever and teleport a short distance after 0.5s.

r.name: Dragon Claws
r.text: Four rapid hits; if early hits miss, later hits deal more, as in OSRS.

passive.name: Justiciar Set
passive.text: Every hit taken is reduced by a flat amount that grows with armour. As a main account, he also has protection prayers.

q.name: Shove
q.text: Dragon spear: knock the target back and stun for 0.75s.

w.name: Elysian Ward
w.text: Shield an ally for 4s; each hit on them has a 70% chance to be reduced by 25%.

e.name: Bulwark Block
e.text: Plant Dinh's bulwark: taunt nearby enemies for 1.5s and take 20% less damage.

r.name: Warstrike
r.text: Bandos godsword: charge and slam; damage dealt is also stripped from the target's armour for 6s.

passive.name: Rune Pouch
passive.text: Lunar spells cost runes, her mana; Astral runes regenerate over time. (Not yet implemented.)

q.name: Heal Other
q.text: Spend 20% of her health to heal an ally for more, as in OSRS.

w.name: Vengeance Other
w.text: The ally reflects 75% of the next hit they take within 5s.

e.name: Energy Transfer
e.text: Give an ally 25% spec energy at a cost of her health.

r.name: Disruption Field
r.text: Allies in range heal and negate the next hit they take within 3s.

passive.name: Level up!
passive.text: Never fights with weapons. Basic attacks toss freshly mined ore (+30% skill power). Every 4th ability sets off OSRS level-up fireworks that damage nearby enemies and heal 5% max health.

q.name: Timber!
q.text: Press Q to plant a yew at the cursor. Yews are solid: nothing walks or dashes through them. Up to 3 at once (a 4th replaces your oldest); each lasts 60s. Press Q with the cursor on one of your yews to chop it (you walk over if needed): it falls straight away from where you stand, hitting everything along its length and slowing them 30% for 1.5s. Planting has a 1.5s cooldown; chopping uses the full cooldown.

w.name: Bonfire
w.text: Lights logs at a spot for 4s. Enemies inside burn every half second; allies inside eat cooked food and heal (Cooking).

e.name: Harpoon
e.text: Harpoons an enemy and reels them in up to 4 m, then holds them for 0.5s.

r.name: Anvil Drop
r.text: An anvil falls from the sky. After 0.8s it crushes everything under it and stuns them for 1s.
